title: Admin
description: Listings under review, role requests, deals, ratings and the market events journal are handled here.

review.emptyDescription: Listings priced far from other sellers in the region land here.
review.approved: Listing approved and live in the market
review.noCompare: No prices in the region to compare with yet
review.reasonHint: (optional; the seller sees it in their listings)
review.reasonPlaceholder: For example: one zero too many in the price
review.noCompareReference: Few sellers in the province — compared with the official price

roles.emptyDescription: Requests from market administrations land here when they sign up.

deals.emptyDescription: Deals show up here when a seller taps “Sold”, a buyer confirms one after a contact, or a request ends in a deal.
deals.latest: {count, plural, one {The latest deal is shown.} other {The latest # deals are shown.}}

ratings.help: Comments with 1–2 stars appear on the seller's page only after you publish them. Hiding removes just the comment: the stars still count in the average.
ratings.published: Comment published on the seller's page
ratings.emptyDescription: When a buyer leaves 1–2 stars with a comment, the comment waits here before it is shown.

events.intro: Events are marked on the analytics charts and offered as a likely cause of sharp price moves.
events.cacheNote: Analytics pages may take up to 10 minutes to show changes.
events.deleteDescription: “{title}” will disappear from the analytics charts and the explanations of sharp moves.
events.emptyDescription: Add events such as frost, an export ban or a holiday: they help explain price moves.

form.description: With the right dates and region the event lands on the right charts.
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: For example: Heavy frost damaged greenhouses
form.endsOnHint: Leave empty for a one-day event
form.notePlaceholder: Extra details, for the team only

ago.minutes: {count, plural, one {# minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}
ago.hours: {count, plural, one {# hour ago} other {# hours ago}}

monitoring.alertsHint: Checked every hour: price flow from each source, the share held for review, scheduled jobs, exchange rates and weather.
monitoring.allClearDescription: The last check found no problems.

messages.source_silent: No prices from “{source}” in the last 24 hours (usually {usual} a day).
messages.source_drop: Prices from “{source}” dropped sharply: {value} in the last 24 hours, usually {usual}.
messages.source_spike: Far more prices from “{source}” than usual: {value} in the last 24 hours, usually {usual}. It may be spam or a double upload.
messages.review_share: {share} of the prices in the last 24 hours were held for review (usually {usual}). The parser or a reference price may be broken.
messages.job_failed: The last run of “{job}” ended with an error.
messages.job_stuck: “{job}” has been running since {when} without finishing.
messages.fx_missing: Central Bank exchange rates have not been loaded yet.
messages.fx_stale: {count, plural, one {Central Bank exchange rates are stale: the latest day is # day old.} other {Central Bank exchange rates are stale: the latest day is # days old.}}
messages.weather_missing: Weather data has not been loaded yet.
messages.weather_stale: {count, plural, one {Weather data is stale: the latest day is # day old.} other {Weather data is stale: the latest day is # days old.}}

monitoring.notified: Sent to admins in the bot

jobs.title: Scheduled jobs
jobs.hint: The last run of every job. Running for more than 2 hours means stuck; no run for longer than its usual gap means overdue.

anomalies.rule: Rule: |z| > 3.5 on the log price (median and MAD), against the province's past 28 days or against the other provinces. A lasting move, or a day next to a holiday or event, is not flagged.
anomalies.semantics: Confirm to keep the day out of the charts and statistics; dismiss to bring it back. Flags on the last 4 days are provisional and the day stays in the charts.

layersHint.temporal: Far from the province's last 28 days
layersHint.cross_section: Jumped while other provinces did not

anomalies.provisionalHint: The next 4 days are not in yet: the day stays in the charts
anomalies.confirmHint: The day leaves the charts and statistics
anomalies.dismissHint: The day comes back to the charts and statistics
anomalies.confirmed: Confirmed: the day is out of the charts
anomalies.dismissed: Dismissed: the day is back in the charts
anomalies.emptyDescription: The daily price history has no sharp, unexplained jumps.

suspicious.advice: This score blocks no one. It shows how unlike the others a seller's last 60 days look (Isolation Forest): who is worth a look.
suspicious.notEnoughDescription: Scoring starts once there are at least {min} active sellers.
suspicious.scoreHint: 0 to 1: from {threshold} unusual, near 1 very unusual
suspicious.live: {count, plural, one {# live listing} other {# live listings}}

features.deviation: Typical gap from the province median
